ISW, Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment, 22 November 2026 (understandingwar.org and criticalthreats.org 403 on direct fetch; key takeaways taken from Kyiv Post republication https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90867, 23 Nov 2026, paraphrased by fetch tool; ISW's own reporting)
- Russian air defences activated in Baltiysk, Kaliningrad Oblast on 21 November; ISW: "the reason for the air defense activity remains unclear."
- Ukrainian forces struck two Russian vessels near Benghazi, Libya, destroying at least one.
- A Russian jet-powered drone violated Moldovan airspace twice on 21 November amid Russian strikes against western Ukraine.
- Ukrainian forces struck Russian military infrastructure in Krasnodar Krai overnight. Russia launched 186 long-range strike drones at Ukraine overnight.
- Both Ukrainian and Russian forces recently advanced southwest of Druzhkivka and southwest of Dobropillya; Ukrainian forces also advanced within and east of Dobropillya.
- (Search snippet, criticalthreats.org mirror:) Russian forces continued offensive operations east of Slovyansk on 21-22 November but did not advance; Russian forces operating in the northeastern outskirts of Kupyansk-Vuzlovyi per geolocated footage posted 22 November, after what ISW assesses was an infiltration mission.
- (Search snippet:) Russian forces struck 20 Ukrainian oblasts with about 2,700 long-range drones, nearly 1,460 glide bombs, and 165 missiles in the past week (c. 15-22 November) — Zelensky's figures.
